title: A secret new Elizabeth Holmes documentary stuns Telluride | TechCrunch
summary: Called “You Can See Everything,” the film is said to capture Holmes and her husband, Billy Evans, in the 34 days before she reported to federal prison in May 2023 to begin an 11-year sentence for defrauding investors about her blood-testing technology.
